The cause is the ladders' extension lines through the view; reported as annotation_leader_crossing.

The strips (dims::placement::strip) give a plan's horizontal dimensions the strip above it and its vertical ones the strip left of it whichever side their feature is nearer; draftwright's own sheet puts these callouts in a column right of the plan, which its Y ladder above the side view leaves free (maintainer question (2) of d-quality-lanes). Re-routed when ctc04's identical slots began sharing one counted width (2× 75, 2× 140, 2026-10-24): two width dimensions fewer reshuffle the ladders, and the joint assignment found these crossings in place of ten others (33 listed → 31).
